claims.claim: Open the enrollment page at Billing → Enrollment. Route: /facility/{facility_uuid}/billing/enrollment.
claims.reason: The Billing Dashboard tile is labelled 'Payer Enrollment' (BillingDashboard.tsx:2960-2967).

claims.claim: PTAN is Medicare-only. Commercial payers, Medicaid, TRICARE, ChampVA — none of them use PTAN. The field is optional at the transaction level and is only checked by Medicare intermediaries.
claims.finding: Payer/regulatory fact, not product behavior. The product does not restrict PTAN to Medicare payers: any payer with a PTAN in its box gets providerTransactionAccessNumber (request-provider-enrollment/enrollment-identity.ts:44-82).

claims.claim: PTAN is MAC-specific. Medipyxis stores one PTAN per facility today, which matches the wound-care norm (a facility bills one MAC).

checks.note: true only if there is no per-enrollment PTAN

claims.finding: Medipyxis stores a group PTAN on the facility (facility.ptan, backend/supabase/migrations/20260810120000_add_ptan_to_facility.sql) AND a PTAN per payer enrollment (stedi_enrollments.provider_ptan, request-provider-enrollment/handler.ts:420); the enrollment page has optional per-payer PTAN boxes (frontend/src/components/billing/stedi/PayerPtanFields.tsx).
claims.proposed_text: PTAN is MAC-specific. Medipyxis keeps one group PTAN on the location and can store a different PTAN for each payer enrollment.

proposed_checks.pattern: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ptan text;

claims.claim: PTAN is not the same as NPI. NPI is national and payer-agnostic; PTAN is Medicare-specific and MAC-scoped. Both go on the enrollment.
claims.reason: The NPI/PTAN definitions are regulatory facts, not checked.

claims.claim: PTAN lives in facility_billing_settings.ptan.

checks.note: true only if PTAN is read/written on facility_billing_settings

claims.finding: PTAN lives in facility.ptan (backend/supabase/migrations/20260810120000_add_ptan_to_facility.sql; read at frontend/src/services/billingConfigService.ts:60-66; written by request-provider-enrollment handler.ts:191, 342-360) and per enrollment in stedi_enrollments.provider_ptan.
claims.proposed_text: The location's group PTAN lives in facility.ptan; each payer enrollment also stores the PTAN it was sent with.

claims.claim: It is entered by an admin on the Enrollment page (/billing/enrollment) — the PTAN field on the provider block. Also validates format (4–10 alphanumeric characters, or blank).
On Admin → Billing Setup — same underlying field, different surface. Either place updates the same row.

checks.note: true only if a Billing Setup surface exists

claims.finding: No 'Billing Setup' screen exists at v1.1.345 and no other UI edits PTAN: outside the enrollment components the only PTAN code is a save-error message in facilityService.ts:716. The enrollment page fills facility.ptan only when it is empty and never replaces a saved value (request-provider-enrollment/enrollment-identity.ts:101-129).
claims.proposed_text: The Enrollment page is the only place to enter a PTAN. It fills the location's PTAN only when none is saved; it never replaces a saved one.

claims.claim: Format rule: PTAN must be 4–10 letters or numbers, or left blank. The field validator names this explicitly when you save something outside the range. Enter what CMS gave you exactly, uppercase, no spaces or dashes.

checks.pattern: "PTAN must be 4-10 letters or numbers, or left blank. Please correct the PTAN field.",
if (ptan.length < PTAN_MIN) return `PTAN must be at least ${PTAN_MIN} characters`;

claims.claim: PTAN is sent on Medicare enrollment requests to Stedi as provider_ptan. It travels with the enrollment record and is written to stedi_enrollments when the enrollment lands.

checks.note: true only if Stedi receives a provider_ptan field

claims.finding: Stedi receives the PTAN as providerTransactionAccessNumber (request-provider-enrollment/handler.ts:449-451), for any payer whose PTAN box is filled, not only Medicare. provider_ptan is the field name the page sends to the edge function and the stedi_enrollments column (StediEnrollmentPage.tsx:377; handler.ts:420).
claims.proposed_text: The PTAN is sent to Stedi as providerTransactionAccessNumber on the enrollment for each payer whose PTAN box is filled, and is saved on that enrollment record (stedi_enrollments.provider_ptan).

claims.claim: PTAN is not sent on individual 837P claims. The claim wire carries NPI (Item 33a) and tax ID (Item 25).

Provider block: Provider name, NPI (10 digits), Tax ID (SSN or EIN, 9 digits, dashes are stripped), PTAN (Medicare only, 4–10 alphanumeric), Provider address (line 1, city, state, ZIP). Contact block: Contact name, Contact email, Contact phone.
claims.reason: Labels on screen: 'Organization / Provider Name', 'NPI', 'Tax ID (EIN)', 'Provider PTAN', 'Address', 'City', 'State', 'ZIP', 'Contact Name', 'Contact Email', 'Contact Phone'.

claims.claim: Payer(s) — searchable list pulled from Stedi's payer catalog.
Transaction type(s) — check the ones you want registered: professional_claim_submission (837P), eligibility (270/271), claim_status (276/277), remittance (835).

checks.note: true only if claim status is an option

claims.finding: There are three options, not four: 'Professional Claims (837P)', 'ERA / Remittance (835)', 'Eligibility (270/271)' (frontend/src/components/billing/stedi/EnrollmentTypesCard.tsx:6-10), mapped to Stedi professionalClaimSubmission / claimPayment / eligibilityCheck (request-provider-enrollment/handler.ts:95-99). No claim-status option. Claims and Eligibility are pre-checked; ERA is off by default because ERA enrollment moves ERAs away from any other clearinghouse (EnrollmentTypesCard.tsx:12-18).
claims.proposed_text: Transaction type(s): Professional Claims (837P), Eligibility (270/271), and ERA / Remittance (835). Claims and Eligibility are checked by default; ERA is off by default because enrolling ERA with Stedi stops ERA delivery through any other clearinghouse.

claims.claim: Every checked transaction type creates one enrollment record. Enrolling one provider with three payers for two transaction types produces six enrollment records.

checks.pattern: // One POST /enrollments per (payer x transaction type)

claims.claim: Submit sends the whole batch to Stedi via the request-provider-enrollment edge function.
Stedi returns a per-(payer, transaction) status: some may land as active immediately, some as pending, some as error with a rejection reason.
claims.reason: Results show Stedi's own status code per (payer, transaction) or the error text; the words active/pending are not literal labels.

claims.claim: The Current Enrollments panel [...] refreshes after submit so you see what actually landed without a page reload.
The Current Enrollments panel below the form [...]
claims.finding: Layout is not grep-checkable, and the code contradicts it: the Current Enrollments card is rendered above the form cards (frontend/src/pages/StediEnrollmentPage.tsx:493-497 vs EnrollmentTypesCard/ProviderInfoCard/ContactInfoCard at ~611-646).
claims.proposed_text: The Current Enrollments panel above the form refreshes after submit.

claims.claim: Active / Pending / Error. While pending, submitting a claim for that payer will fail with a routing error at Stedi. Pending can take from minutes to weeks (Medicare, some Medicaid states). The error message is verbatim from Stedi.
claims.reason: Only 'error message verbatim from Stedi' is code-checkable; Stedi/payer timing and routing behavior is external.

claims.claim: Enrollment errors also land in the Stedi Actions Inbox as enrollment.rejected events, with the full context and the recommended next step. Check for enrollment.task.assigned events.
claims.reason: Page heading is 'Stedi Actions'. Whether a synchronous enrollment error (returned to the form) also becomes an inbox event depends on Stedi sending a webhook; not checked.

claims.claim: PTAN entered with a hyphen or space. The validator rejects anything outside [A-Za-z0-9]{4,10}.

checks.pattern: export const cleanPtanInput = (value: string): string => value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "");
checks.note: true only if hyphens/spaces are rejected rather than removed

claims.finding: On the Enrollment page hyphens and spaces are silently removed, not rejected: cleanPtanInput (frontend/src/components/billing/stedi/payerPtans.ts:13) and cleanPtan in the edge function (request-provider-enrollment/enrollment-identity.ts:22-24) strip non-alphanumerics, then only the length (4-10) is checked. The DB CHECK on facility.ptan rejects them only on a direct facility save.
claims.proposed_text: PTAN entered with a hyphen or space: the Enrollment page removes them; the remaining letters and numbers must be 4–10 characters.

proposed_checks.pattern: export const cleanPtanInput = (value: string): string => value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "");

claims.claim: NPI/PTAN mismatch with Medicare is the most common enrollment reject. MAC processing can legitimately take 4–8 weeks. Stedi sometimes needs a form signed manually before Medicare will finalize.
claims.finding: Payer/Stedi process facts; not checkable from code.

claims.claim: Wrong tax ID shape. The field accepts SSN or EIN. Medipyxis strips dashes and whitespace before sending, so 12-3456789 and 123456789 both work — but 12-345678 (8 digits) fails.

checks.note: true only if Medipyxis itself refuses a tax ID that is not 9 digits

claims.finding: Dashes are stripped (handler.ts:181), but nothing in the enrollment page or function checks for 9 digits; an 8-digit tax ID is sent to Stedi and fails there, if at all. The field label is 'Tax ID (EIN)' (EnrollmentFormCards.tsx:117).
claims.proposed_text: Medipyxis strips dashes and spaces before sending, so 12-3456789 and 123456789 are the same. It does not check the digit count — count the digits before you submit.

claims.claim: Medipyxis registers enrollments with Stedi; it does not enroll providers with payers.
claims.reason: Enrollment requests go only to Stedi's enrollment API.

claims.claim: Enroll all four transaction types the first time — submission, eligibility, claim status, remittance.

checks.note: true only if four types can be chosen

claims.finding: Only three types exist (EnrollmentTypesCard.tsx:6-10), and ERA is deliberately off by default because enrolling ERA with Stedi stops ERA delivery through a previous clearinghouse (EnrollmentTypesCard.tsx:12-18). Advising everyone to enroll remittance on day one contradicts that.
claims.proposed_text: Enroll Professional Claims and Eligibility the first time. Add ERA / Remittance only when this practice is ready to receive ERAs through Stedi instead of another clearinghouse.

proposed_checks.pattern: Switching a provider to Stedi stops ERA delivery through the previous
